data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 mislabels the relation as a 'shared mechanism' when it actually describes a contradiction/difference in calculation forms. By its own admission, $909 'abstracts into' a base-for-all-plus-premium-only form while $855 'uses the standard replacement form' — these are structurally incompatible representations of the overtime computation, differing in 'whether the overtime rate replaces or supplements the base rate.' A relation that identifies two artifacts as diverging in their core representational logic is a contradiction, not a shared mechanism. The target's 'REFUTED IF' reinforces the mislabeling: it only tests whether the premium is shared, ignoring the real substantive relation it surfaced — that the two forms are incompatible abstractions of the same rule.
